purpose: REGF3 version of grid M: the same network, operating point and events, with the REGF3 unit (dVOC) in the slot; the monitor grid for the held-out device.

case.name: grid_M3
case.description: Kundur two-area re-arranged another way: device in GENROU 3's slot; all three 7-8 tie circuits in service; one of the two 5-6 circuits (Line_1) out; PQ_2 at bus 10 doubled to 300 MW; bus-7 load 1000 MW, bus-8 load 1150 MW; GENROU 2 at 500 MW and GENROU 4 at 650 MW; device at 650 MW with a 1.01 pu voltage schedule; device REGF3

device_under_test.params_note: ANDES inputs. The six REGF1 parameters drawn the way REGF1's and REGF2's were (ANDES defaults scaled by numpy default_rng(seed).uniform(0.7, 1.3, 6) in the order wdrp, Qdrp, Tpm, KPplim, KIplim, Tr; wdrp and Qdrp times Sb/Sn), with seed 2, so the three units share no numbers; KPv = 6 as for the other two. REGF3 (dVOC) has no parameters of its own: its dVOC gain Kdvoc is a constant ANDES computes from wdrp and Qdrp (about 1.6e-10 here), and Qdrp enters only through it. The same device sits in grids A3, B3 and M3.

design_notes: Grid M with REGF3 instead of REGF1 (Nov 15), so the held-out device is tested on the grids the two training devices were tuned on and only the device differs. Grid M's dispatch and schedule were chosen for REGF1's damping; they have not been re-checked for REGF3.

Under REGF3 the staged voltage-reference steps barely move the unit: ANDES's dVOC gain Kdvoc is about 1e-10, so Vset enters its equations almost not at all, and in steady state the unit holds Q (no Q-V droop). The steps are kept so the events match grids M and M2 exactly.

The runs are the same three kinds as grid B's (a voltage-reference step, a load change, a line opening) but in other places, directions and sizes, on a different arrangement at a similar strength, so a real improvement should show on both grids.

Damping decided the operating point. The first draft (680 MW, 0.99 pu schedule) left the true device with a 0.93 Hz mode at a damping ratio of 0.009, and its voltage-reference run swung V between 0.84 and 1.15 pu. At 650 MW and 1.01 pu the least-damped mode is 0.92 Hz at 0.056, next to grid A's 0.058 (0.59 Hz, op1) and grid B's 0.079 (0.53 Hz), from ANDES EIG with the true device in the slot.
Damping falls as the voltage drops, so the voltage-reference step goes down only 1.5%: at -2.5% the lowered setpoint sat in a less damped region and the 0.9 Hz swing barely decayed for 12 s.

The line opening is a 6-7 circuit. Opening a 9-10 circuit moved the device's P by an RMSE of only 0.0019 pu, under the scorer's 3-sigma floor (0.003), so a flat model scored 0.97 instead of 1. The 6-7 circuit moves P and Q by 0.021 and 0.037 (B_line: 0.016 and 0.069).

Deliberately wrong models cost within about 25% of what they cost on grid B, except a 30% low KPv, which saturates two of M's three runs (1.04 against 0.53 on B; grid A's held-out runs saturate too). See monitor_check.json.
